page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance configured for large enterprise workloads requiring balanced compute and memory capacity. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The system provides 256 GB of total memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. There is no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached cloud disks for persistent storage needs, and the instance includes no hardware GPUs.

Network performance is backed by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating substantial throughput for distributed services and data synchronization across cloud clusters. The 64 dedicated cores ensure consistent execution without hypervisor-level CPU contention from neighboring tenants. However, the absence of integrated local NVMe storage means that I/O-heavy operations are strictly bound by network block storage latency and bandwidth limits.

Cost efficiency is centered around horizontal and vertical resource consolidation, allowing organizations to avoid multi-instance management overhead by deploying extensive services on a single footprint. The instance is suited for multi-tier enterprise web architectures, large relational databases, in-memory caching layers, backend microservices clusters, and medium-scale continuous integration or data processing pipelines.
